cards.imageAlt: Figure 19，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please say something about the pictures.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对图片进行一些描述。
cards.referenceText: In the left picture, there is a large aircraft with four turboprop engines cruising over mountains, and the right picture shows the movement principle of the air over mountains, which causes turbulence of the aircraft. A flight is cruising over mountains and it is crossing invisible bodies of air which are moving vertically at many different speeds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。左图里，一架有四个涡轮螺旋桨发动机的大型飞机正在山上巡航。右图展示的是山顶空气的运动规律，这会引发湍流。飞机正在山顶巡航，并穿过在不同速度下垂直运动的不可见空气。

cards.audioText: What may happen when the aircraft fly over mountains?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞过山顶时可能会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: They may experience mountain wave turbulence while flying over mountains, where air passes over mountains and causes turbulence as it flows above the air on the other side.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在飞过山顶时可能会遭遇地形波湍流，当空气从山的另一边刮过，空气经过山顶引起地形波湍流。

cards.audioText: Can you explain mountain wave turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能够解释地形波湍流吗？
cards.referenceText: Mountain wave turbulence is a type of clear air turbulence (CAT), and the wavelike effect is characterized by updrafts and downdrafts occurring above and downwind from a mountain range when rapidly flowing air encounters the mountain range’s steep front.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，地形波湍流是晴空湍流其中的一种。地形波效应的特点是当快速流动的空气遭遇山脉陡峭的前沿时，山脉上方和顺风处出现上升气流和下沉气流。

cards.audioText: How do you know clear air turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对晴空湍流有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, firstly, it usually cannot be foreseen or detected by aircraft radars so there is no warning. Secondly, it is usually felt at its mildest in the flight deck and is generally severer in the after section. Thirdly, it can occur when no clouds are visible. Lastly, it is common at high altitudes, where cruising airliner may suddenly enter turbulent areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，第一，晴空湍流通常无法被预测或被雷达探测到，所以晴空湍流没有预警。第二，驾驶舱能感受到晴空湍流时，湍流最温和，通常在尾部非常剧烈。第三，晴空湍流可以在没有云可见时出现。最后，晴空湍流通常发生在高海拔地区，巡航的飞机可能会突然进入湍流区域。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you encounter clear air turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行时遭遇晴空湍流，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I would follow the aircraft turbulence procedure, avoid abrupt control inputs, and ensure that passengers and cabin crew are seated with their seat belts fastened. I would report the turbulence to ATC and coordinate any necessary change of level or route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会执行本机型的颠簸程序，避免突然操纵，并确保旅客和客舱乘务员就座、系好安全带。我会向空管报告颠簸，并协调必要的高度或航路调整。

cards.audioText: Why can clear air turbulence not be detected by radar?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么晴空湍流无法被雷达探测到？
cards.referenceText: Turbulence associated with clouds and thunderstorms can be displayed on the airplane’s radar screen because the movement of water droplets can be detected by radar waves, and moving droplets mean moving air masses which mean turbulence. Clear air turbulence, by definition, has neither visual phenomenon associated with it, nor any water droplets, so it is invisible to be detected by radar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为雷达波能探测到水滴的运动，所以与云和雷暴相关的湍流能被雷达探测到。水滴运动意味着移动的气团，相当于湍流。晴空湍流，顾名思义，既没有相关的视觉现象，也没有任何水滴运动，所以无法被雷达探测到。

cards.audioText: Is turbulence totally undetected? If not, do you know some techniques to detect it?
cards.audioTextZh: 湍流是否完全无法被探测到？如果不是，你知道哪些能够探测到湍流的技术？
cards.referenceText: No, as far as I know, it can be remotely detected with instruments that can measure turbulence with optical techniques, such as scintillometers or Doppler LIDARs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不是，湍流可以被利用光学技术的仪器远距离探测到，例如激光闪烁仪或多普勒激光雷达。

cards.audioText: Can you specify the notion of turbulence in aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能够详细解释航空中湍流的概念吗？
cards.referenceText: Turbulence is air movement that normally cannot be seen. It may unexpectedly occur when the sky appears to be clear, and it can be created by some different conditions, including atmospheric pressures, jet streams, mountain waves, cold or warm fronts, or thunderstorms.
cards.referenceTextZh: 湍流是通常不可见的空气流动。天晴时湍流可能会意外出现，它也会因为一些特殊情况出现，包括大气压力、喷流、地形波、冷风或暖风，或雷暴。

cards.audioText: What routes you have flown are more difficult than others?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过的航路中有哪些更难飞？
cards.referenceText: I think routes flying to Kunming or Dalian are more difficult. We usually have to deal with the high-altitude airfield and heavy season-wind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 让我想想，我认为从昆明到大连的航线比较难飞。通常必须要处理高海拔机场和强烈季风的问题。

cards.audioText: Is the clear air turbulence easy to avoid? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 晴空湍流容易避免吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I don’t think so, because clear air turbulence can be detected neither with the naked eyes nor with conventional radar, so it is difficult to avoid
cards.referenceTextZh: 不容易避免，因为晴空湍流既不能被肉眼发现也不能被常规雷达探测到，所以很难避免。
